item.title: Receive a Bracha From On High on the Rebbetzin’s Yahrzeit
item.description: On the Rebbetzin’s yahrzeit, the Rebbe requested that chassidim add in charitable giving to institutions established in her name, in the numerical value of her name, 470. Full Story

item.title: From Reb Levi Yitzchok: Always Follow the Middle Path
item.description: Insights from Toras Harav Levi Yitzchok Schneerson, the Rebbe's father, presented by Shliach Rabbi Dovid Dubov of New Jersey, for Yisro: Always follow the Middle Path. Full Story, Video

item.title: Expanded Wellness Summit at Kinus Gives Shluchos Practical Tools
item.description: This year, at the Kinus Hashluchos, a full-day Wellness Summit will give shluchos practical tools for navigating the demands of their lives from a calmer, more grounded place. Full Story

item.title: CKids Welcomes Shluchos Aboard the Mobile Canteen
item.description: At this year’s Kinus Hashluchos, CKids invites all Shluchos aboard the CKids Gan Israel Mobile Canteen to enjoy complimentary coffee and special treats, for themselves and their families back home. Full Story

item.title: Live: 45th Global Siyum HaRambam in New York
item.description: Live at 7:15 PM ET: Join the international Rambam celebration for concluding the 45th cycle. Featuring inspiring speakers, illustrious Rabbonim, and music and nigunim with Avraham Fried and Yaakov Stark. Live

item.title: Preparations Complete as Thousands Begin Arriving for Kinus Hashluchos
item.description: After months of preparation, final touches are being put in place today as Crown Heights prepares to welcome more than 4,500 shluchos from over 100 countries for the annual Kinus Hashluchos, the International Conference of Shluchos. Full Story

item.title: New Daily Rambam Podcast Strengthens the Rebbe’s Takanah
item.description: Rabbi Yacov Barber has launched a new daily Spotify podcast dedicated to the Rebbe’s takanah of learning Three Chapters of Rambam each day. Full Story

item.title: Kinus Workshop Will Support Shluchos In Helping Meaningful Matches
item.description: Thursday at the International Kinus Hashluchos, CYP’s Met@Chabad will present two workshops designed to give shluchos the tools to guide singles in building a Jewish home: preparing for marriage and finding the right match. Full Story

item.title: Grand Siyum HaRambam and Farbrengen at Toronto Yeshiva
item.description: As Lubavitcher communities and Yeshivos worldwide celebrated the 45th and 15th cycles of Siyum HaRambam on Chamisha Asar B’Shvat, the Toronto Yeshiva marked the occasion with a grand Siyum of its own. Full Story

item.title: Grand Siyum Harambam at Tomchei Temimim Morristown, NJ
item.description: Over 300 people attended a Siyum Harambam in the beautiful Zal of Tomchei Temimim Morristown, NJ. A special highlight was a presentation on the historic first Siyum Harambam in 5745. Full Story, Photos
